meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键发布 npm 包到生产环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护 npm 包并需要自动化发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Publish npm packages to production with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain npm packages and need automated release

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把 oh-my-opencode 发布到 npm。它会触发 GitHub Actions 的发布流程，检查版本号（patch/minor/major），等待构建完成，验证 npm 包和 GitHub Release 是否成功，最后在 Discord 发公告。
howto.when: 当你要求发布、部署或 npm publish，并指定版本类型（patch/minor/major）时触发。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本到 npm。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行完整发布流程。

say.text: 帮我发布 minor 版本，版本号升到 1.2.0。
say.note: Claude 会确认 bump 类型后触发工作流。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will publish oh-my-opencode to npm. It triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, waits for the version bump type (patch/minor/major), monitors build stages, verifies npm packages and GitHub release, and posts a Discord announcement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to publish, release, deploy, or npm publish, and provide a version bump type (patch/minor/major).

say_en.text: Publish a patch version to npm.
say_en.note: Claude will start the full publish workflow.

say_en.text: Publish a minor version, bump to 1.2.0.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm the bump type and trigger the workflow.
